summary: George Russell converted pole position into victory at Baku, repelling a determined late assault from Max Verstappen across two safety car restarts that compressed the final laps. Lando Norris escalated tensions by demanding a ban for Franco Colapinto after the Alpine driver triggered a restart incident that cost the McLaren driver positions. Russell's win narrows the championship gap as Kimi Antonelli, the points leader who crashed in qualifying, salvages points from 16th on the grid.
